title: Batched Wavefront Sweeps for Linear Transport Uncertainty Quantification
summary: We develop a graph-compatible batched wavefront formulation for upwind discontinuous Galerkin discretisations of linear transport. For sweepable discretisations, the cell equations form a block lower-triangular system under a topological ordering of the directed upwind dependency graph. This causal structure can be shared across families of fixed-source problems whose local operators, sources and inflow data vary.
